title: Study Quiz Deck
description: Schema for Study Quiz deck files.

description.description: Short description shown under the deck name.

id.description: Unique identifier for this question. Convention: m{mod}_{index}, e.g. m1_1.

mod.description: Module number. Questions with the same mod value are grouped together for filtering.

mod_name.description: Human-readable module name displayed in the quiz UI.

opts.description: Answer options. For T/F questions this must be ["True", "False"].

ans.description: Zero-based index of the correct answer within opts.

type.description: Question type. Omit or set to MCQ for multiple choice. Set to T/F for true/false questions.

exp.description: Optional explanation shown after the user answers.
